campaign.title: The vscode-extension project type, the preview verb and the rebrand toolkit
campaign.status: Design DESIGN-002 written and this plan proposed; Phase 0 spikes are read-only facts recorded in DESIGN-002 §1 and in the consumer's repository. Next: Phase 1 (contract and specifications), then Phase 2 (the type package), Phase 3 (the preview verb), Phase 4 (the first consumer, in its own repository), Phase 5 deferred by name. Owner review points are OPEN below; the campaign proceeds on the conservative reading of each and records the ruling verbatim when it arrives.
campaign.mandate: Я хочу научить codkit делать форки плагинов vscode. [...] продумай глобально архитектурно как это в целом может делаться. Как codkit определяет тип продукта, стратегии и так далее. [...] Надо будет поставить typescript-ai-native и применять его к новому собственному коду. [...] твоя задача как большой модели - придумать как доработать codkit так, чтобы мы могли быстро и удобно дорабатывать множество плагинов. Также специально в качестве исключения я бы придумал какой-то способ быстро предпросматривать результаты работы в каком-то из существюущих IDE на основе VSCode (пока тренируйся на дефолтном, но потом мы перейдем к кастомному) [...] патчсет имеет лицензию EULA, и у результирующего плагина лицензия тоже EULA. Это всё максимально не опенсорс, и не source available. Кроме тех частей кода, которые унаследованы от codkit
campaign.mandate-note: The elided parts of the mandate name the consumer product, its upstream and its repository; they are recorded verbatim in the consumer's own campaign plan (`common/PROP-004` `NO-CONSUMER-PRODUCT-IN-THE-TOOL`, DESIGN-002 D8). The same owner message set the session goal in the same words.
campaign.source: DESIGN-002-vscode-extension-type.md (vibevm/vibespecs/research/design), written 2026-11-01 from the type contract (PROP-016, `packages/type-api`), the `generic` and `theia` types as the two precedents, PROP-005/PROP-010/PROP-003 as digested on 2026-11-01, and the facts of one measured specimen kept in the consumer's repository.

baseline.fact: Three official types are registered: `vscode`, `generic`, `theia` (`codkit types` on 9e7d474); the contract has ten areas and the closed capability list `brand-images, gen-brand, build-channels, runtime-library, own-extensions, service-override, entry-module, config-overlay, dev-channel, upgrade-advisory` (`packages/type-api/src/capabilities.ts`).

No verb of the roster launches, installs, serves or previews a product; `package --keep-overlay` leaves a tree for a hand check and the quickstart runs the fork's own launcher by hand (PROP-007 roster, docs/codkit/reference/commands.md, human protocol 01-quickstart, read 2026-11-01).
No verb creates a patch set; the human protocol writes `codkit.json` by hand and proves it with `where`, `check-tree --require-clean` and `verify` (human protocol 15-project-types, read 2026-11-01).

The layer order is own → service-override → entry-module → config-overlay → resource-file → rewrite-rule → patch; no layer substitutes terms; an overlay is path-wise set/remove over JSON; `rewrite-rule` is `line-ops` without a replace action (PROP-005, read 2026-11-01).

The `vscode` type answers `gen-brand` with a rules table (`delta/own/common/brand.ts`, `createBrandTransform(RULES)`) and a printed hook into the `nls.ts` funnel (modules/vscode/PROP-008 `GEN-BRAND`); the transform lives in `runtime-vscode` (`common/brand/brandRules.ts`).

Gates on 9e7d474: format, typecheck, runtime emit, type receipts, trace (302 files, 158 units), docs, public formats, mirror tests, `vibe check --quiet` green; `publishScrub.test.ts` carries the pre-existing failure CK-A76; the structural floor and the full Vitest suite were not run on this machine today.
The owner's machine: VS Code 1.144.0 with `code` on PATH, Node 24.18.0, npm 11.16.0, cargo 1.93.1, no `bun`; the first consumer's upstream pins `bun@1.4.4` and `engines.vscode ^1.105.1`.

decisions.decision: The specimen and the consumer are named only in the consumer's repository; Codkit's specifications, code, tests, fixtures and this plan speak of "the family" and "the specimen" (DESIGN-002 D8). Rejected: a research directory `research/-facts` here, as was done for Theia - that upstream is one step from a consumer product, Theia was not.
A type of its own, `vscode-extension`, configured through `typeConfig`, not a profile of `generic` and not a variant of `vscode` (DESIGN-002 D1).

`preview` is the eleventh area of the contract, optional and paired with a capability like `brand-images`; the engine owns isolation, the record, the lock and the restore; the type owns the recipe (DESIGN-002 D4). Rejected: a type-specific verb; the upstream's own launcher.

The rebrand toolkit uses existing layers and the existing `gen brand` machinery: manifest overlay, brand table with hooks at each funnel, resource files, hook patches, and a generated leftover guard test; no term-substitution layer (DESIGN-002 D3).

The brand transform is generated self-contained; no runtime library for this type in the first version (DESIGN-002 D5). One universal `.vsix`; platform targets later (DESIGN-002 D9). Brand images later (DESIGN-002 D6).
Codkit-side work lands on `main` in atomic commits per phase, each with the floor pieces that run on this machine; the consumer's work lands in its own repository and is not a commit of this one.

predictions.prediction: After Phase 1, `codkit types` prints the three existing rows unchanged except for the new capability name in the contract's list; after Phase 2 it prints a fourth row `vscode-extension` with `configurableCapabilities` empty and the declared capabilities `config-overlay, entry-module, build-channels, upgrade-advisory, gen-brand, preview`.

The engine blindness gate (PROP-016 `TYPE-ENGINE-IS-BLIND`) stays at zero hits with the family's tokens (`extensionDevelopmentPath`, `vsce`, `engines.vscode`) added to its dictionary: the engine learns them from the type's answers only.
`projectTypeProblems` refuses a type that declares `preview` without the area and one that answers the area without the capability, by the same test that holds `brandImages` today.
`npm run kit` carries `@codkit/type-vscode-extension` as a fifth type tarball without a change to the kit builder beyond the registry row.
The generated leftover guard test goes red on a fixture tree that keeps one original brand string outside the allow-list and green when the string is inside a licence file.

A fake host executable (a Node script that records its argv) proves `codkit preview` passes `--extensionDevelopmentPath`, `--user-data-dir` and `--extensions-dir` with paths under `.codkit/preview/`, and never a path under the person's home.

route.phase: Design and spikes, no commits: DESIGN-002; the specimen measured in the consumer's repository; the host flags confirmed against the installed VS Code; vibevm bootstrap of an empty project studied. Complete 2026-11-01.

Contract and specifications: `preview` capability and `PreviewArea` in `@codkit/type-api` (and the manifest handshake); PROP-016 amendments (`TYPE-AREA-PREVIEW`, the capability in `TYPE-TERM-CAPABILITY`); PROP-007 `CMD-PREVIEW`; `modules/vscode-extension/PROP-001..005`; FEAT-002 scenarios; specmap regenerated; docs regenerated. Exit: `vibe check --quiet`, specmap --check, trace:check, typecheck, docs:check green.

The type package `@codkit/type-vscode-extension`: configSchema, identity, layout, layers, build, advisory, conventions, generators (feature skeleton, brand graft with the self-contained transform and the leftover guard template), preview recipe; type-manifest; the registry row; the root scripts; the kit; the synthetic polygon fixture (a minimal extension repository with a manifest, an activation module and two dictionary modules); unit suites. Exit: the package's suites green, `codkit types` prints the row, `npm run kit` carries it, the receipts refreshed, the floor pieces green.

The `preview` verb: `lib/previewEngine.ts`, `commands/preview.ts`, the roster and the help, the error codes with FAQ entries, the record and the state directory, overlay materialization and restore, the e2e suite with a fake host, a manual test for the real host. Exit: e2e green, docs regenerated, the manual test pre-run against the installed VS Code reported (never recorded as a pass).

The first consumer: its vibevm project, its EULA posture through the organization policy, its `codkit.json` of type `vscode-extension` over the pinned upstream, `standards load`, the rebrand set generated and completed, `load`, `package`, `preview` in the installed VS Code. The proof is reported in the consumer's repository; this plan records only that the type passed it.

`codkit init --type --pin ` writing the first configuration from a pinned clone; `seams-vscode-extension`; brand images from the manifest's icon targets; `typeConfig.packageTargets` for platform-specific `.vsix` files; an MCP surface for `preview`; the namespace-rename intervention as a product decision.

review-points.point: Owner-only: whether a namespace rename of commands and settings (the upstream's `.` identifiers) is part of the first change or a later one. Conservative reading applied: displayed strings only.

Owner-only: whether the consumer keeps the upstream's service endpoints and telemetry destination in the first build. Conservative reading applied: telemetry destination removed in the consumer's set; endpoints untouched and listed.

Owner-only: whether `bun` may be installed on the owner's machine through npm for the consumer's build. Conservative reading applied: installed only when the consumer's phase reaches the build, through `npm install -g bun@`, and reported.

quick-start.step: Read DESIGN-002 and this plan; `git log --oneline -5` on main; `node packages/codkit/bin/codkit.mjs types`.

Phase 1 starts in `packages/type-api/src/` (add `preview.ts`, extend `capabilities.ts`, `OPTIONAL_AREAS`, `index.ts`) and `vibevm/vibespecs/modules/vscode-extension/`; regenerate `specmap.json` with `vibe bin exec --quiet typescript-ai-native -- specmap` and the docs with `node tools/generate-codkit-docs.mjs`.

Gates per boundary: `npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run runtime:build && npm run runtime:check && npm run types:check && npm run trace:check && npm run docs:check && vibe check --quiet && vibe bin exec --quiet typescript-ai-native -- specmap --check`, plus the Vitest files the phase touched.

acceptance.script: npm run kit && grep -c type-vscode-extension target/supply-kit/kit-manifest.json

deferrals.deferral: Brand images from the manifest's icon targets - DESIGN-002 D6.
`codkit init --type` and the pin bootstrap from a clone.
A `gc` class for `.codkit/preview//` of a tree that is gone (PROP-007 `CMD-PREVIEW-ISOLATION`); `--clean` removes it until then.
The leftover guard reads the `.vsix` as a zip (the archive carries the same files; a zip reader is not a dependency the product is promised to have).

`gen brand --funnel bundler`: the bundler funnel of the brand (the own module that reads a source through the table under the locale its path names) as a generated template; today the hook text describes it and the consumer writes it.
`codkit preview --workspace ` under its specified name, once the global `--workspace ` and the command flag are reconciled; `--workspace-dir` until then.

Specification discrepancies found while reading on 2026-11-01 (PROP-007 `COMMAND-ROSTER` lacks `workspace`, `config migrate`, `marker reason`, `consumer-check`; `CMD-WHERE` vs the docs on the printed type; PROP-003 `CFG-SCHEMA`/`CFG-PIN-TAG` predate v4; the second notice copy path differs between PROP-007 and PROP-014) - for the next health audit, not this campaign.

log.entry: Phases 1-3 closed. Phase 1 landed as four commits (the audit and the commit map, the design and the plan, the contract area `preview`, the family's specifications). Phase 2: `@codkit/type-vscode-extension` with its four suites (68 tests), the registry row and receipts, the root scripts, the kit entry; P1-P3 held. Phase 3: `preview` with `previewEngine`/`previewHost`/`previewIsolation`, 11 e2e scenarios over a fake host and 14 unit tests; P6 held with one reading - on Windows the fixtures live under the profile directory, so the suite asserts both isolation directories under the state directory. Decisions taken while landing: the brand graft carries an optional `guard` the engine writes (PROP-016 `TYPE-AREA-GENERATORS`); the transform's word boundary is Latin, so a locale written without spaces is reached (PROP-005 `VSX-BRAND-RULE-SHAPE`); the guard scans the built bundle, the manifests, the documents and the asset names, not the archive (DEF-8), in the words of the declared runner; a product whose strings do not all pass a translate function grafts the table into its bundler (`VSX-BRAND-HOOK`); `marker new --new-file` and the add-file exemption for a file without a marker form, because the locale manifests of an extension are JSON (PROP-007 `CMD-MARKER-NEW`, PROP-006 `ADD-FILE-EXEMPTION`); `--workspace-dir` (DEF-10). P4 (`npm run kit` carries the sixth tarball) held; P5 (the guard on a fixture tree) is the consumer's proof.

Phase 0: four read-only studies (vibevm sources, the specimen, the CLI and licensing specs, the layer and build specs), the installed host's flags, the type contract and the two precedent types; DESIGN-002 written with nine decisions; this plan proposed. No tree change outside the two documents.
